prompts.pdi:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Asset type: full-page portrait editorial illustration for chapter 02 “Ricerca, persone e culture” of an Italian design booklet.
Input image 1 is the EDIT TARGET. Recreate this same artwork with its chapter-correct color palette. The user's requested change is the chapter color; preserve the composition, visual metaphor, arrangement, figures, architecture, curved paths, silhouettes, framing, scale and generous white negative space as faithfully as possible.
Color palette: replace EVERY red or crimson accent of the input with the chapter's light orange, orange 300, HEX #FFB86A, RGB (255,184,106). This light orange must be the dominant chromatic accent, closely matching that exact swatch. Keep dark shapes near-black/charcoal, pale surfaces NEUTRAL gray and white, and the background PURE WHITE #FFFFFF. Fine grain is allowed inside forms only; make orange areas sufficiently clean and light to clearly read as #FFB86A. Use only this orange, black, neutral gray and pure white. No red, crimson, burgundy, saturated dark orange, beige, cream or warm paper.
Style/medium: same sophisticated geometric surreal editorial screenprint collage, crisp curved contours, subtle fine ink grain inside shapes, substantial architectural volumes. Preserve the two metaphorical halves with equal dignity.
Composition/framing: same portrait 3:4 aspect ratio as the input, artwork position and image boundaries. Preserve the quiet white lower band, approximately bottom 15–18%, for native typography later. Preserve the open white upper space. Do not add any text, title, caption, lettering, numerals, logos, watermark, frame or border.
Subject and meaning: POWER DISTANCE · PDI. Left: five people exchange a single ribbon around a round table on the same level, expressing parity. Right: equally dignified people stand at different heights on stepped architectural terraces, joined by the same ribbon, expressing accepted hierarchy. Preserve table, arches, stairs and all key figures. All ribbons, circles and surfaces that were red become light chapter orange #FFB86A.
